edit.description: Early same-clock historical forecasts, smoothly approach frozen static teachers
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity response is unverified: no decoded final affinity labels are present, so improved affinity cannot be claimed from coordinate contrasts alone.
Strain and structural validity are not assessed by this reward edit; changed chemical graphs are permitted but coordinate similarity does not establish improved affinity.
The observed landmark_00_soft_mass curve is a coordinate proxy with 4 sign changes and batch-level sign conflicts (F005), so the staged schedule may not generalize across independent batches.
S1 is a proposed intervention level, not an optimal parameter learned from a temporal slope; if the smooth blend does not change the actual trace, the edit should not be credited.
No extrapolation beyond observed score nodes is licensed; any schedule evaluation outside [0.0,0.49] would be invalid.
rationale: Analyst H001/H002 report the landmark_00_soft_mass curve (Eef4385e476674774) is non-monotone with an interior peak near t=0.16 and sign reversal, with large early rate (+9.27) reversing to -10.00 by the last node, and no landmark soft-mass feature has polynomial_accepted=true or a stable same-sign whole-window z (E2e106e083189d150). This supports a smooth time-dependent relevance schedule rather than a fixed absolute coordinate target or a hard knot. S1_observed_to_static is the registered reward-lane recipe that starts from early same-clock historical forecasts and smoothly approaches frozen static teachers over the observed score nodes, matching the observed early-window dominance and gradual decay without extrapolation. The objective (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1) and clock support [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed nodes (E0857891f4effbfe1) confirm the schedule is confined to the licensed support.
